purpose: Bind Havenwild terrain providers into one source-sheet/profile system so the mapper and editor can resolve exact authored source cells without visual guessing.
sourceProfileRule: A source sheet profile describes exact 32px cells, grouped regions, seasonal/provider identity, topology role, layer role, collision defaults, compatibility, and runtime promotion status. It does not replace semantic worldgen authority.

canonicalSourceFamilies.role: current fallback/runtime provider until seasonal source profiles are fully mapped and certified
cliff faces, crests, feet, terminals, ladders, and cave hosts
complete 3x4 directional ramp stamps and related contour modules
waterfall cap, face, and foot stamps

statusMeaning.draft_mapped: Exact source cell exists in a draft/correction scene.
statusMeaning.learned_mapping: User corrected/accepted scene evidence exists for the source cell.
statusMeaning.validated_mapping: A handoff/export exists, but runtime publication still requires stricter certification.
statusMeaning.published_runtime: Reserved for cooked/runtime terrain registry publication.

resolverContract: Worldgen emits provider-neutral semantic terrain/topology roles.
The Terrain Lane resolver selects a mapped source profile and exact source rect for the current season/material/context.
V7 remains the fallback provider until seasonal source sheets are fully mapped and certified.
The renderer draws exact source rects; it never visually searches or guesses art at runtime.
mapperUiContract: Left panel preloads sheet cards from Havenwild asset authority and lazy-loads selected textures.
Source sheet preview shows per-cell status badges.
Inspector shows source profile, provider, coverage, semantic role, topology, layer, collision, and compatibility.
Correction scenes produce evidence, not runtime publication.
